scope: Unchanged MIT Windows SDK GUI with standalone native SCROLLBAR controls translated into Wasm inside the browser with Wine base DLLs. Seven stages verify five controls against classic native pixel captures in EXE/ZIP/catalog modes. Actual mouse, keyboard, 32-bit thumb tracking and compiled parent callbacks are exercised. Nonclient bars, alignment/size-box styles, mouse auto-repeat, complete subclass behavior and universal Windows/DLL support remain unfinished.
oracleReference: Wine 11 x86 native classic SCROLLBAR; uxtheme disabled, normalized system palette
